instruction: Open the Chrome settings to manage different browser configurations.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to Chrome's main settings page (chrome://settings/). This has the same difficulty and complexity as the original password manager task - both involve simple navigation to Chrome internal pages. The evaluator uses existing functions: is_expected_active_tab_approximate metric and active_url_from_accessTree getter to verify the active tab URL matches chrome://settings/.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses active_url_from_accessTree getter to extract the active tab URL from Chrome's accessibility tree
Metric is_expected_active_tab_approximate appropriately compares URLs while ignoring query parameters, which is suitable for chrome:// internal pages that may have variable query strings
Expected URL chrome://settings/ correctly corresponds to Chrome's main settings page as required by the instruction
Evaluator provides complete coverage - instruction requires navigating to settings page, and evaluator verifies exactly that
Data flow is correct: getter extracts URL string → metric compares against expected URL → returns binary pass/fail
The goto_prefix being empty string is correct for chrome:// URLs which already include the protocol
Logic will work correctly at runtime - no edge cases or semantic issues identified
